name: Laws of the Cook Islands (consolidated Acts and subsidiary legislation)
label: Cook Islands
record_note: cookislandslaws.gov.ck publishes only the current consolidation, so each law has one version here: the text as retrieved on 2026-10-29, dated by the latest day its own record (Table of Amendments, history notes, commencement) gives for a change taking effect. Earlier text is not available; the notes and tables are kept as text and in data/amendments.csv.

dates.commit: latest past commencement or history-note date of each law (In-force-basis trailer), else its own commencement or assent, else the retrieval day
dates.time: 12:00 Pacific/Rarotonga (UTC-10:30 until 1978-11-12; UTC-10 with half-hour summer time until 1991-03-03; UTC-10 since)
dates.before_1970: clamped to 1970-01-01; the real day is in the trailer

scope.when_absent: not extracted for the Cook Islands; savings and transitional rules are in the amending laws

default_reach.meaning: an enactment is presumed not to affect rights acquired, or proceedings begun, before it took effect unless it says so
default_reach.authority: common-law presumption; the Acts Interpretation Act 1924 as in force in the Cook Islands (in this repository) governs the effect of repeals
